text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to understand images and videos. At its core, it involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what an object is, and object detection, which locates where that object is within a picture. These abilities power many everyday tools, from face-unlock features on phones to photo-sorting apps that recognize your friends. Perhaps the most exciting application is in self-driving cars. Using cameras and sensors, the car's vision system detects pedestrians, road signs, and other vehicles in real time, allowing it to make safe driving decisions. While still improving, this technology is already making our lives easier and holds great promise for the future.
